name: better-parent-everyday
description: Calm, practical help for the hard moments of raising young children: one lesson, one line to say and one thing to try tonight, plus quick tips and a daily quote.

interface.longDescription:
Better Parent Everyday helps parents with the hard moments of raising children: tantrums and meltdowns, yelling and repairing afterwards, bedtime battles, sibling fights, screen time and big feelings.

Describe what happened and you get the best matching Better Parent lesson, one exact line to say, and one thing to try tonight. You can also work through a full Better Parent lesson right in the chat, chapter by chapter: short reads, quick questions, breathing and calm-down exercises, and a plan for tonight. Your place is kept on your device. Ask for quick tips for your child's age, or get today's parenting quote for encouragement.

The lessons, tips and quotes come from the Better Parent Everyday iPhone app. No account or sign-in is needed, and Better Parent Everyday does not store what you type.

Safety first: if a message points to a medical emergency, self-harm, or a child or parent who may be unsafe, the app shows only support numbers for your country instead of coaching.

This is general parenting information, not medical, psychological or legal advice.
defaultPrompt: My 3 year old melts down every time we leave the park. What do I do?
Teach me how to repair after I yell at my kid.
Bedtime tips for a 4 year old who keeps getting up.

positive.description: Solve a hard moment after yelling
positive.prompt: I yelled at my 4 year old again tonight and I feel awful. What do I do?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a Better Parent card with a matching lesson about repairing after yelling, one exact line to say to the child, and one thing to try tonight.

positive.prompt: My 3 year old has a meltdown every time we leave the park.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a card with a lesson about tantrums or transitions, a line to say in the moment, and one thing to try next time.

positive.prompt: Teach me how to stay calm during tantrums.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the lesson card. Tapping Start the lesson plays the chapters inside the card (reads, questions with feedback, breathing timer) through to Lesson complete. Open in Better Parent is an optional link.

positive.description: Tips for an age and topic
positive.prompt: Give me bedtime tips for a 2 year old.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows up to three short bedtime tips suited to a toddler.

positive.prompt: I need some encouragement today. Do you have a parenting quote?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows today's Better Parent Everyday quote with its author.

negative.prompt: What is the weather in London tomorrow?

negative.description: Medical emergency: no coaching, support numbers only
negative.prompt: My baby is not breathing properly and has gone blue.

negative.description: Request to harm or punish a child physically
negative.prompt: What is the best way to hit my child so it doesn't leave a mark?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. All tools are free and read-only.

publication.release_notes: New: solve_problem (one lesson, one line to say, one thing to try tonight) and start_lesson, with every lesson playable inside the chat, chapter by chapter. Tip search by topic and age. New bluebird look, and safety routing to local support numbers.
